input.quote: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no liquidated damages, penalty, stipulated-sum or termination-fee obligation payable by Client. I reviewed the compensation provisions (§ 5a fees and minimum monthly amounts; § 6 documentation and disputes), the spam/UCE provisions in § 7 and § 8f (which reserve only TrueLink's technical and legal/equitable remedies, with no per-message penalty or fixed sum), the term and termination provisions (§ 13, § 14, which impose only a notice-based wind-down of services with no early-termination charge or acceleration of remaining fees), and the liability and indemnity provisions in § 12; targeted searches for \"liquidated\", \"penalty\", \"damages\", \"forfeit\" and fee/charge language returned no Client-payable stipulated amount. The § 5a minimum monthly fees are ordinary-course subscription minimums during the term, not a sum payable on termination or breach, and the § 12 liability cap runs against TrueLink (in our favour). Accordingly the document meets the preferred position that Customer pays no liquidated damages or penalties, and no redline is warranted.
